property_summary: For all valid inputs (non-empty _tos array) C.transfer(...) completes and returns true; the mutant returns false for the same inputs, so the reference always returns true while the mutant can return false.

The reference contract always returns true from transfer whenever the call completes (does not revert); the mutant instead returns true or false depending on whether _tos.length is even, so for some fuzzed _tos the return value differs while both executions succeed.

For every call to transfer that completes (does not revert), the reference C always returns true; the mutant returns true iff the length of _tos is even, so some successful calls (odd lengths) return false and violate this rule.
